title: $639.96 to See Grandma's Porch? 🚪 | Verdict Picks Toon Ep.3 #Shorts
description:
Grandma June can't see who's at her door. Jo wants a video doorbell without a monthly bill.

Verdict Picks Toon, Episode 3. Our full guide to video doorbells without a subscription, with three-year costs:
https://acts39.blogspot.com/2026/11/video-doorbells-without-subscription.html

Facts in this Short: Ring without a plan gives live view, not saved video; Ring Solo is $49.99 a year (ring.com). Three-year totals from our guide (Target and maker prices, November 11, 2026): eufy E340 $119.99, Ring with Solo $189.96, Nest with Premium $499.99, Ring with Pro $639.96. eufy says the E340 keeps about 90 days of clips on 8 GB inside.
